confidence_notes: Holistic estimate for July 2026. Meals and coffee follow lower-cost East Java pricing; accommodation varies with the Ijen visitor season. Draft beer and especially cocktails and wine are less certain because availability and venue choice vary; cocktail and wine prices are estimated relative to beer. No live city-price listings were consulted.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on lower-cost East Java towns with a visitor economy, adjusted for Banyuwangi's role as an Ijen gateway and its prices being below Bali's.
